description.value: Papa's Burgers is a homestyle burger joint on Vancouver Island's Highway 19A corridor in Parksville, known for hand-cut fries, creamy milkshakes, and poutine made from fresh daily ingredients. The restaurant has built a strong local following with consistently five-star Google reviews praising food quality and service. A touring cyclist rolling through Parksville would find this a well-regarded quick-service stop with online ordering available.
